scope: Validate bounded update proposals as an exact compare-and-swap all-or-none shadow transaction, prove rollback, and record count-only cost without mutating the live graph.

atomicity.unit: all proposed parameter families from one objective event

cost.measurement: integer base plus integer per prepared target

persisted: transaction requested, prepared, shadow-applied and rollback-verified flags
per-family prepared and role-neutral reason codes
per-family CAS result and observed current value
per-family shadow applied and rollback values

compatibility.v0116_checkpoint: upgrade allocates empty transaction metadata without fabricating applied writes
compatibility.birth: event and transaction history starts empty
compatibility.clone_checkpoint_compaction: committed transaction evidence is copied exactly
compatibility.death: transaction evidence is cleared with the row

forbidden: mutating any SubjectVMStorage parameter in Stage 3C-3
partial application after one family fails
charging entity energy for count-only cost units
counting shadow application as applied plasticity
claiming transaction success as learning, adaptation or subjecthood
